Sandbox_NEV_SpawnRate_tooltip: How often new energy vehicles appear. 1 = default: about 2 %% of the cars in ordinary parking spots, more in rich areas; other vehicle mods do not change it. 0 = none. Applies to areas not visited yet.
Sandbox_NEV_EnergyUse_tooltip: Electricity used for driving and standing powered on.
Sandbox_NEV_Regen_tooltip: Electricity recovered when slowing down without throttle.
Sandbox_NEV_FastChargeTime: Fast charge time (x vanilla full refuel)
Sandbox_NEV_FastChargeTime_tooltip: Time for a 0-100%% fast charge, where 1 = filling a tank at a vanilla gas pump (about 13.6 game minutes), scaled by battery size (75 kWh = 1). Default 2: about 18 game minutes for the Li L6. Higher is slower.
Sandbox_NEV_SlowChargeHours: Home charger: BEV full charge time (game hours)
Sandbox_NEV_SlowChargeHours_tooltip: Game hours for a home charger to fill an empty BEV battery (about 100 kWh). Default 7: one sleep on an ordinary bed when tired, so it is full when you wake up. Smaller batteries fill sooner, by capacity (Li Auto L6 about 3.5 h).
Sandbox_NEV_RexNoiseHybrid_tooltip: Percent of a vanilla engine. Also used when EV priority holds the charge.
Sandbox_NEV_AccessoryEnergyUse_tooltip: Also applies to the heater / AC while driving.
Sandbox_NEV_AirFilter_tooltip: No corpse sickness builds up inside a new energy vehicle while all its doors and windows are fitted, unbroken and closed (no power needed).
Sandbox_NEV_InfotainmentTV_tooltip: When off, the infotainment screen of new energy vehicles is a radio only: no TV channels, no tapes. Vehicles already on the map change the next time they load; a tape inside goes into the glove box.
Sandbox_NEV_GeneratorFuelFactor_tooltip: Multiplier on the fuel charging equipment burns on generator power, like a vanilla appliance. Default 1: a home charger burns about what an ordinary household appliance does while it charges, a power station what the vanilla battery charger does; it depends on how long it charges, not on how much energy goes in. Fast charging at a gas station only costs the pump itself (vanilla). Also scaled by the vanilla generator fuel consumption setting. Grid power is free.
Sandbox_NEV_AllowFastCharge: Allow fast charging at gas pumps
Sandbox_NEV_AllowFastCharge_tooltip: Gas pumps with electricity can charge new energy vehicles.
Sandbox_NEV_FridgeOffCarHours_tooltip:
Game hours the car fridge keeps working after the car is powered off; then it pauses until the car is started again. Camping mode does not count.
0 = no limit.
Sandbox_NEV_ParkedRecharge_tooltip:
A parked range-extender car below 3 %% charge with fuel in the tank starts its range extender and stops at about 28 %%.
It makes range extender noise even when nobody is near and may attract zombies.
